verdict.rationale: Parsec's downloads page lists a 'Web – Google Chrome' client, and its share-a-link feature lets a team member observe or take control of a computer. This points to browser-based viewing and control, but the evidence names only Chrome, never says a session works with nothing installed, and never ties shared links to the web client. Missing for 10: confirmation of zero-install browser access, support for browsers other than Chrome, explicit link-to-browser session flow, independent hands-on corroboration.
